description: Zener Diode Independent 20V 350mW Surface Mount SOD-123

provenance.pins: two-terminal Zener, DO-214AC/SOD outline: pin 1 = cathode-band end, pin 2 = opposite. Polarity from the package drawing, not inferred from function

designVerdict: REJECTED. Superseded by BZT52C27 (C173421). A 20 V clamp holds the HUSB238A VBUS pin below its own 22.4 V vVBUV_F2 disconnect threshold, so the board could not have held a 36 V contract.
notes: RETIRED ARGUMENT: Hynetek's reference specifies 28 V. 20 V is chosen deliberately for margin: it puts the VBUS pin at roughly 18.5 V, comfortably inside its 3.15-29.4 V window, where a 28-30 V Zener would place it at ~28.5 V against a 29.4 V recommended maximum. The chip functions we rely on - VBUS presence detection and supply backup - work anywhere in that range, and OVP/UVP are lost to the clamp topology regardless.
DEVIATION FROM THE VENDOR REFERENCE. Worth validating that nothing else depends on the pin tracking VBUS more closely.

Was fitted as D1 for four revisions on the argument that 18.5 V sits 'comfortably inside the 3.15-29.4 V window'. That window is the recommended operating range, not the disconnect logic. The p.7 undervoltage table bands the falling threshold three ways and only vVBUV_F2 (RDO >= 26 V, a flat 22.4 V) applies at this design's headline PDO. The analysis that chose this part covered F0 and F1 and never reached F2.
